data.current_location: Western Jezero Crater rim / Lac de Charmes area (18.44° N, 77.45° E)
data.source_name: NASA Science: Mars 2020 Perseverance Mission Overview

data.title: Broom Point Investigation
data.description: Perseverance completes high-resolution multispectral analysis of ancient layered bedrock at Broom Point on the upper crater slope, discovering evidence of diverse sedimentary transport mechanisms.
data.current_location: Western Jezero Crater rim / Lac de Charmes area (18.44° N, 77.45° E)
data.source_name: NASA Science: Mars 2020 Perseverance Mission Overview

data.title: Interstellar Flight at >163 AU
data.description: Continues transmitting real-time plasma and cosmic ray measurements from interstellar space.
data.current_location: Interstellar Space (Outer Heliosheath, ~163 AU / 24.4 billion km from the Sun)
data.source_name: NASA Science: Voyager 1 Mission Dossier

data.title: Ascending Upper Sulfate Terrains
data.description: Reaches higher elevation sulfate layers documenting Mars drying transition with over 33 km total driving.
data.current_location: Gediz Vallis / Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons), Gale Crater, Mars (4.59° S, 137.44° E)
data.source_name: NASA Science: Mars Science Laboratory Curiosity Rover Dossier

data.title: Exploration of Lac de Charmes & Jezero Rim
data.description: Continuing its extended mission, Perseverance conducts scientific reconnaissance around the western Jezero rim and Lac de Charmes area, sampling ancient crustal rocks that may hold records of the earliest Noachian epoch on Mars.
data.current_location: Western Jezero Crater rim / Lac de Charmes area (18.44° N, 77.45° E)
data.source_name: NASA Science: Mars 2020 Perseverance Mission Overview
